reason: Entries: only the fall-through from LDA #&04 / STA os_ram_copy / STA romsel (no branch/JMP/table reference to player_done in src; passcost.mjs uses the label only for profiling, label kept), so A = &04 and TRB acccon clears exactly ACCCON bit 2, as cpu_sees_main's AND #&FB did. LDX/STX of back, crtc_start_address_high/low into flip_screen/flip_crtc_hi/lo store the same bytes in the same order. I flag: cpu_sees_back ends in CLI on both paths; between it and player_done the only SEI/PHP in reachable code (render.6502, kindcache_build, sfx50, game.6502 rows_up/prebuild PHP..PLP) are paired or PLP-restored; the game.6502 SEIs (3459, 4459, 5506, 5969) and bank5's are outside render. So I = 0 and the dropped CLI is a no-op. Interrupt: TRB is one instruction, so irq1_handler's own LDA/STA acccon read-modify-write cannot interleave, same protection as SEI..CLI; flip_pending is set only after render returns (wait_for_timer_281a), so an IRQ after the flip_* stores acts the same in both. Exits: JMP restore_game_zp begins LDA and never reads X/flags, ends RTS (stack depth unchanged: the JSR/RTS pair is gone). Returns: wait_for_timer_281a does SEI; LDA field_count (flags rewritten), then RTS to update_movers' caller -> JMP main_game_loop (LDX #&70 first); observer loop -> observer_mode_loop (LDX #&86 first); rewind_column -> LDA; RTS -> DEC respawn_left / respawn (no X read); render_to_main -> SEI; LDX #&0C. A, X, Y, N, Z, C, V all dead on exit; D unchanged both ways. cpu_sees_main stays (cpu_sees_back falls/branches to it). Cycles: old JSR 6 + SEI 2 + LDA abs 4 + AND 2 + STA abs 4 + CLI 2 + RTS 6 = 26, new TRB abs 6: 20 saved; LDX/STX equal LDA/STA. Bytes: JSR abs 3, TRB abs 3: 0.
